Name: Qinfeng - TV Channels
Author: mxyster534
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Added some TV series to your TV, including 'Water Margin'.[/color]
增加一个电视节目《水浒传》。

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI and front-end mod( 'Custom TV Channel' (nexus:24278) ) are required. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]需要SMAPI和前置模组 'Custom TV Channel' (nexus:24278)。[/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Every day, click on the TV to play clips of "Water Margin". Different plot clips will be randomly given to players as small gifts by the connected characters.
每天点击电视播放《 水浒传 》片段，不同的剧情片段，连的角色会随机赠送玩家一些小礼物。

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This work is based on the mod 'Custom TV Channel' (nexus:24278).[/color]
基于24278模组运行，请安装该尾号的模组。

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thank you for the Three Kingdoms TV module with reference module number 31588.
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]参考模组编号31588的三国演义电视模组，特此感谢。[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Also, I haven't figured out how to add multilingual support yet, currently only Chinese is available.[/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]另外，还没搞懂如何添加多语言支持，暂时只有中文。[/color][/size]
